specialNotes:
DUPLICATE OF PS01__MustersRoad. Created 17-Sep-2026.

This job code exists solely to hold a simplified, strictly-legal-minimum Permitted Development drawing pack for submission to the planning officer (Rushcliffe Borough Council), kept deliberately separate from PS01's more complex builder's drawing set.

Reason for the split: the real project uses a detailed builder's set of drawings that is overkill for a Permitted Development application. Rather than maintain two divergent versions of the same model/drawing layouts inside one job (TrueVision is not yet set up for that kind of parallel version control), this is a completely separate job number so the two data sets cannot bleed into each other.

TrueVision 3D and PlanVision content in this project folder was copied verbatim, byte-for-byte, from PS01 on 17-Sep-2026 and has NOT been adjusted. Adam will manually strip the drawing layouts back using the Layout Editor and re-save simplified GLB model exports over the copied files himself.

All client-facing admin documents here (welcome letter / quotation / invoice / special terms) have been stripped back to placeholders that point back to the live case, PS01. This project is not separately billed - all fees and payment history live under PS01.

Client PII has NOT been duplicated to this project code (no data pushed to R2 for PS02). See PS02__README__DuplicateOfPS01__.md in the project root for the same note.

PIN: reuses PS01's PIN hash verbatim (same client, same portal access code).
